movelist.name: Shadow Ball
movelist.effect: Shadow Ball lowers the foe’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Captivate
movelist.effect: Captivate lowers the target’s Special Attack 2 Combat Stages. Captivate may not affect something that is the same gender as the user or something that is genderless.

movelist.name: Wake-Up Slap
movelist.effect: If the target is Asleep, Wake-Up Slap has a Damage Base of 10 (3d8+10 / 24) instead, and cures the target of Sleep.

movelist.name: Ominous Wind
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Draining Kiss
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

abilities.name: Magic Guard
abilities.effect: The user is immune to damage and Hit Point loss from Hazards, Weather, Status Afflictions, Vortexes, Recoil, Hay Fever, Iron Barbs, Rough Skin, and Leech Seed. Defensive.

abilities.name: Snow Cloak
abilities.effect: The user gains +1 Evasion. This is increased to +2 Evasion while in Hail or snowy terrain. While in Hail, the user and adjacent allies do not lose Hit Points due to the Hail.

abilities.name: Frostbite
abilities.effect: The user’s damaging Ice-Type attacks cause the target to become Slowed on 18+, and the Effect Range for Freeze on these Moves is increased by +1. If the Move does not cause Freezing, it now causes Freezing on a roll of 20.
